name: AETHER · PRISM
iconSvg:
<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 256 256' width='256' height='256'>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id='prismTile'>
      <rect x='2' y='2' width='252' height='252' rx='54'/>
    </clipPath>
    <radialGradient id='aetherGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00f0ff' stop-opacity='0.28'/>
      <stop offset='38%' stop-color='#818cf8' stop-opacity='0.16'/>
      <stop offset='72%' stop-color='#f59e0b' stop-opacity='0.06'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#010204' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='prismFaceLeft' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00f0ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#082f49' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='prismFaceRight' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#818cf8' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1e1b4b' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='prismFaceTop' x1='0.5' y1='0' x2='0.5' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#38bdf8' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beamCyan' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00f0ff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00f0ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beamAmber' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f59e0b' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f59e0b' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beamViolet' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#818cf8' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#818cf8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='rimOuter' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#818cf8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f59e0b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x='1' y='1' width='254' height='254' rx='54' fill='#010204'/>

  <g clip-path='url(#prismTile)'>
    <rect width='256' height='256' fill='#010204'/>
    <rect width='256' height='256' fill='url(#aetherGlow)'/>

    <!-- Subtle Geometric Coordinate Guides -->
    <g stroke='#38bdf8' stroke-width='0.75' opacity='0.22' fill='none'>
      <circle cx='128' cy='128' r='96' stroke-dasharray='3 5'/>
      <circle cx='128' cy='128' r='64' stroke-dasharray='1 4'/>
      <line x1='32' y1='128' x2='224' y2='128' stroke-dasharray='2 6'/>
      <line x1='128' y1='32' x2='128' y2='224' stroke-dasharray='2 6'/>
    </g>

    <!-- Dispersed Spectral Refraction Rays -->
    <g stroke-linecap='round'>
      <!-- Incident Beam (Electric Cyan) from top-left -->
      <line x1='36' y1='56' x2='110' y2='116' stroke='#00f0ff' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.95'/>
      <line x1='36' y1='56' x2='110' y2='116' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.0' opacity='0.8'/>

      <!-- Refracted Dispersed Beams toward bottom-right -->
      <!-- Cyan Upper Beam -->
      <line x1='146' y1='124' x2='226' y2='98' stroke='url(#beamCyan)' stroke-width='2.4'/>
      <!-- Amber Mid Beam -->
      <line x1='146' y1='132' x2='232' y2='142' stroke='url(#beamAmber)' stroke-width='2.6'/>
      <!-- Violet Lower Beam -->
      <line x1='142' y1='140' x2='222' y2='186' stroke='url(#beamViolet)' stroke-width='2.4'/>
    </g>

    <!-- Central Geometric Prism Core (Faceted Diamond/Prism) -->
    <g stroke='#00f0ff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'>
      <!-- Top Pyramid Facet -->
      <polygon points='128,68 98,114 158,114' fill='url(#prismFaceTop)' stroke='#f8fafc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
      <!-- Bottom Left Facet -->
      <polygon points='98,114 128,188 128,114' fill='url(#prismFaceLeft)'/>
      <!-- Bottom Right Facet -->
      <polygon points='158,114 128,188 128,114' fill='url(#prismFaceRight)' stroke='#818cf8'/>
      <!-- Front Floating Diamond Core -->
      <polygon points='128,88 146,128 128,168 110,128' fill='#07090e' fill-opacity='0.6' stroke='#00f0ff' stroke-width='1.8'/>
      <circle cx='128' cy='128' r='4' fill='#f8fafc'/>
      <circle cx='128' cy='128' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#f59e0b' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    </g>

    <!-- Hairline Prism Nodes / Spark Points -->
    <g fill='#f8fafc'>
      <circle cx='128' cy='68' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='98' cy='114' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='158' cy='114' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='128' cy='188' r='2'/>
      <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#00f0ff'/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Precision Dual Border Frame -->
  <rect x='2' y='2' width='252' height='252' rx='54' fill='none' stroke='url(#rimOuter)' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <rect x='6' y='6' width='244' height='244' rx='50' fill='none' stroke='#00f0ff' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.55'/>
</svg>
